definition.description: From a tall stance on one declared leg, rapidly lower without intentional flight into a shallow controlled single-leg athletic position, hold without a hop, step, hand, or free-foot touchdown, then return and reset. One repetition is one same-leg non-flight drop and terminal stick; it excludes a cut, sprint stop, rebound, jump, or bound.

environment.surface: clean dry level non-slip floor with clear one-body-length station
environment.space: one visible unilateral standing station with protected entry and exit
inspection: surface, footwear, clearance, visibility, and stop signal
coach front and side view of foot, knee, pelvis, trunk, free foot, and terminal hold
environment.changeRule: Changing support, laterality, range, surface, cue, rebound, takeoff, hold, dose, symptoms, or substitute requires revalidation.

selectionPrerequisites: pain-free single-leg stance and shallow controlled single-leg squat
understands non-flight drop, same-leg hold, no free-foot touch, stop signal, and reset
safe station and session unilateral lower-body, impact, technical-fatigue, logistics, and duration budgets fit
excludeOrEscalate: pain, giving way, slip, unsafe floor, repeated arch/knee/pelvis/trunk collapse, free-foot touch, rebound, balance loss, or communication conflict
new neurologic, circulation, breathing, chest, balance, or coordination concern
notEstablishedByEvidence: universal range, hold, dose, recovery, readiness threshold, clinical clearance, injury outcome, or performance transfer

provenance.identityAuthority: Landing/braking progressions packet: stable identity is a same-leg non-flight snap-down to terminal stick. Support and reactive cue are variants; bilateral support is a regression; a later jump or bound is a distinct task.

anatomy.laterality: same declared support leg per repetition; record side-specific quality without athlete skill labels
anatomy.claimsBoundary: Describes task mechanics and plausible loading sites only; it does not diagnose, treat, prevent injury, establish readiness, or guarantee transfer.

athleteSupport.whyItMatters: Candidate practice for rapid single-leg position acquisition without adding flight or repeated impact.
athleteSupport.primaryCue: Stay on one leg, snap into a small landing shape, and freeze without tapping the other foot.
expectedSensations: light-to-moderate single-leg thigh, hip, calf, foot, and trunk control effort
high attention to balance and alignment
unexpectedSensations: pain, giving way, foot collapse, knee/pelvis/trunk collapse, free-foot touch, dizziness, or inability to hold
athleteSupport.painGuidance: Stop rather than forcing range or balance through pain, instability, dizziness, or another concerning symptom; report it and follow facility escalation policy.
selfChecks: did not leave the floor before lowering

observationChecklist: exact unilateral no-flight task, declared side, surface, range, no-touch/no-rebound boundary
foot/arch, knee, pelvis, trunk, free foot, terminal hold, asymmetry
valid repetitions, first fault, symptoms, rest, and unilateral exposure

faultCorrections.free_foot_touch: reduce range or speed and restore terminal balance before counting
faultCorrections.arch_knee_pelvis_or_trunk_collapse: reduce demand only if alignment returns; otherwise stop and revalidate
faultCorrections.rebound_or_jump: slow the drop and restate non-flight terminal-hold contract
faultCorrections.balance_loss: add recovery or choose a separately reviewed supported variant after revalidation

demonstrationPlan: show tall one-leg start, non-flight lower, terminal stick, return, and reset
show free-foot clearance and valid hold
show invalid jump, touch-down, collapse, and rebound
confirm athlete can state side, no-touch rule, and stop signal
groupManagement: stagger starts so coach can see unilateral alignment and free foot
record side, valid repetitions, first fault, symptoms, rest, and lower-body exposure
modificationDecisionTree: if pain, giving way, slip, dizziness, unsafe floor, or communication failure occurs, stop and escalate
if alignment or hold cannot be restored, reduce range only if quality returns
if support, reactive cue, bilateral stance, rebound, or takeoff is required, select a separately reviewed exact task and rerun validation
do not automatically substitute a single-leg hop, jump, or bound
doNotUseWhen: the intended task is a hop, jump, bound, cut, sprint stop, assessment, or conditioning
surface, symptoms, unilateral control, supervision, or communication is inadequate

supportOperations.supportEscalation: Stop and escalate unresolved symptoms, unsafe setup, repeated alignment/free-foot/hold loss, or a mismatch between the requested task and this exact non-flight unilateral snap-down contract.
supportOperations.retentionPolicy: Persist definition and variant versions, side, range, valid repetitions, first fault, free-foot contacts, terminal hold, symptoms, rest, substitution, stop reason, and generator/rendering versions under facility policy.
supportOperations.changeImpactPolicy: Any change to support, laterality, range, surface, cue, rebound, takeoff, hold, dose, or substitute reruns selection, fatigue, impact, logistics, duration, substitutions, and validation.

sourceVariant.archiveReason: The source lacks exact non-flight, laterality, free-foot, hold, load, fatigue, delivery, alternate, support, and review contracts.

legacy.description: Balance tall on one leg, lower quickly into a shallow single-leg landing shape without hopping, hold, then reset.
legacy.tempo: tall single-leg start; non-flight snap down; two-second same-leg stick; reset
legacy.loadNote: Low bodyweight unilateral eccentric position acquisition. Exact range, side, hold, rest, and lower-body overlap are delivery-profile specific.
legacy.cardSummary: Candidate unilateral non-flight landing-position card with explicit no-touch, no-rebound, no-takeoff, terminal-hold, and stop boundaries.
legacy.coachLanguage: Count only aligned same-leg drops that own the terminal hold without the free foot.
legacy.athleteLanguage: Stay on one leg, snap into your landing shape, freeze without tapping, reset, and report symptoms.

safety.prerequisiteNotes: Readiness is the exact single-leg non-flight, alignment, terminal-hold, surface, symptom, supervision, and fatigue context—not a participant classification.
readinessChecks: pain-free single-leg stance and shallow single-leg squat
can hold a controlled single-leg terminal position
clean dry non-slip station and known stop signal
session unilateral lower-body and technical-fatigue budgets fit
stopSigns: pain, giving way, slip, repeated foot/knee/pelvis/trunk collapse, free-foot touch, rebound, unsafe station, or participant stop request
inability to restore same-leg terminal control after rest
contraindications: symptom, unsafe surface, inadequate unilateral control, supervision, or communication
support, reactive cue, bilateral stance, rebound, takeoff, or assessment intent without a separately reviewed contract
commonSubstitutions: Use another reviewed task only after full revalidation.
Do not automatically substitute a single-leg hop, jump, bound, or bilateral snap-down.

score.difficultyRationale: Scores describe exercise complexity and physical difficulty for a same-leg non-flight snap-down only, not participant ability, experience, age, or readiness. Unilateral balance, pelvic control, no-touch terminal hold, and alignment exceed the low physical load.

difficultyProfile.notes: Exact unilateral non-flight rapid lower and terminal stick without free-foot touch, rebound, or takeoff.

variants.displayName: Same-Leg Non-Flight Snap-Down to Terminal Stick

programmingProfile.weeklyExposure: candidate_review_required; program from current unilateral lower-body exposure rather than a universal frequency
programmingProfile.completionCriteria: every repetition starts/finishes on the declared leg, has no flight or free-foot touch, holds terminal alignment, and has no stop event
programmingProfile.sequenceRules: Place after bilateral non-flight landing-position ownership and before single-leg hop, jump, bound, or higher-impact unilateral work.
programmingProfile.pairingCompatibility: May pair with mobility, trunk control, or noncompeting upper-body work when station, recovery, and unilateral exposure remain valid.
programmingProfile.interferenceRules: Do not stack with unilateral hop/jump/bound, high-impact landings, exhaustive lower-body work, or testing when terminal control degrades.
programmingProfile.uncertaintyPolicy: Scores, dose, recovery, and progression are candidate planning estimates; require human review and rerun validation after any change.

deliveryProfiles.purpose: Rehearse rapid same-leg non-flight landing-position acquisition and terminal balance without repeated impact.
deliveryProfiles.qualityGate: The declared leg remains the only support, the free foot does not touch, foot/knee/pelvis/trunk remain controlled, terminal position holds, and no stop event occurs.
stopRules: pain, instability, slip, unsafe station, or participant request
free-foot touch, collapse, rebound, or inability to hold
deliveryProfiles.coachInstructions: Declare side and range, show no-flight/no-touch hold, and count only controlled aligned terminal sticks.
deliveryProfiles.athleteInstructions: Balance tall on one leg. Snap into a small landing shape without hopping, freeze without tapping, then reset.
deliveryProfiles.expectedAdaptation: Task-specific unilateral landing-position rehearsal; no universal outcome is claimed.

logistics.station: one visible clean non-slip unilateral station
logistics.durationFormula: setup plus valid repetitions, rest, restarts, recording, and reset

doseScaling.volume: add only while every repetition remains same-leg, no-touch, aligned, and held

supportPrompts.athlete: One leg, no hop, no tap, freeze.
supportPrompts.coach: Foot, knee, pelvis, trunk, and free foot stay quiet.
